deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for the Molecular, Cellular, and Developmental Biology (MCD) and Neuroscience subprograms, or by January 1, 2027 for the Ecology, Evolutionary Biology, and Behavior (EEB) and Plant Sciences subprograms.
deadline.quote: Application deadlines (fall enrollment only): December 1 - Neuroscience subprogram and MCD subprogram | January 1 - EEB subprogram and Plant Sciences subprogram

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for Biology PhD admission.
gre_general.quote: Note that this program does not require the GRE for admission.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Biology, and the Biology PhD program does not require GRE scores.
gre_subject.quote: Note that this program does not require the GRE for admission.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants to the EEB and Plant Sciences subprograms should identify one or two potential faculty mentors in their application and are recommended to contact them beforehand.
supervisor.quote: Applicants should identify one or two possible faculty mentors and indicate your interest in their laboratories on your application. It is recommended that you also contact them directly prior to submitting your application.

funding.value: Almost all accepted Biology PhD students receive five-year CUNY Science Scholarships covering full tuition waivers, stipends, and assistantships.
funding.quote: For students in the Ph.D. Program in Biology, financial support is offered in the form of CUNY Science Scholarships. Almost all students accepted to this program receive such Science Scholarships that include full tuition waivers for domestic and foreign students, directly paid scholarships, teaching assistantships and other funds usually provided from research grants.

entry_route.value: Applicants apply directly with an undergraduate science and mathematics background; no master's degree is required.
entry_route.quote: Unless specifically noted on our deadlines and requirements chart, you do not need to have a master's degree before you start a Ph.D. program.

also.quote: Applicants to the Ph.D. in Biology should have an adequate background of undergraduate study in biology, chemistry, physics, and mathematics, including morphology, physiology, genetics, biochemistry or organic chemistry, and calculus or statistics.
